scope: Eight uploaded portrait references surveyed; twelve selected animated handoffs, three direct-cut controls and five consecutive-frame intervals. No blocked long-form YouTube episode was viewed.

sources.filename: The Deadliest Thing in Your Kitchen.mp4

examples.title: Keep the chosen moon; change its surrounding context
examples.carry: Amalthea remains visible while the title, building and other options recede; the selected object grows/repositions, then shrinks as Jupiter enters.
examples.mechanism: Selective context removal and an animated subject, followed by a scale comparison; not a dissolve between two complete stills.

examples.title: The prop makes room for its consequence
examples.carry: The saffron bowl lifts and tilts while labels retract; the anatomical head rises below it and falling specks connect bowl to brain.
examples.mechanism: Coordinated prop motion, character/diagram entrance and a causal particle path in one shared field.

examples.title: A flapping wing hands its pumping action to bellows
examples.carry: Wing movement continues as a bellows drawing appears at the same working hinge; the illustrated bellows pumps, then moves left along its connecting tube as the lungs enter.
examples.mechanism: Aligned local overlap/replacement, continued deformation, then connected-object reveal. The wing remains partly translucent; footage does not establish a literal topology morph.

examples.carry: The orange/yellow fiber grows, its side fills the frame, then the view changes to elongated molecular strands with moving charge symbols.
examples.mechanism: Scale-through occlusion and a detailed replacement drawing. A cut is present at the change of representation; a seamless private 3D scene is not established.

examples.carry: The already raised cylinder enlarges and shifts into the close view; the concentric top is replaced/revealed as the blue cell network while the orange cylinder remains.
examples.mechanism: Object isolation, enlargement and a local diagram change rather than replacing the entire composition.

examples.title: The moving inset becomes the environment
examples.carry: The rainy inset expands past its border; rain continues, water fills the lower view, and a probe enters the same moving environment.
examples.mechanism: Animated contents persist while their viewport opens. Enlarging a frozen preview would lose the key feature.

examples.mechanism: Subject-led expanding effect with continuing internal band motion, not two whole-frame images crossfading.

examples.carry: The same city/construction model enlarges with its turquoise screen field; the frame and presenter move beyond the view and the model continues its building action.
examples.mechanism: Nested composition expands into the next explanatory space. Subject action continues through the scale change.

examples.title: One moving paper becomes the particle explanation
examples.carry: A paper separates from the falling clutter, remains bright as the room dims, enlarges, then hands its particle figure to the colored diagram while the page recedes.
examples.mechanism: Object selection, staged background removal and a local diagram handoff. Selective opacity contributes, but the moving subject connects the views.

examples.title: The working diagram becomes content on a monitor
examples.carry: The same upper/lower particle groups shrink into a monitor as the desk and scientist are revealed; the scientist settles at the screen.
examples.mechanism: Persistent diagram and animated context reveal. The diagram is not removed and replaced by an unrelated room photograph.

examples.title: The energy effect covers the representation change
examples.carry: The luminous central burst grows to near/full white coverage; the yellow/purple matter–antimatter field emerges around the same central energy shape.
examples.mechanism: Action-caused luminous coverage with a shared center. This does not justify adding unmotivated flashes between other subjects.

examples.title: Control: baby scene to neuron diagram
examples.carry: A direct shot change; no observed object travels through this boundary.
examples.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Do not cite this as a continuous zoom or morph.

examples.title: Control: whole Io to volcanic surface
examples.carry: The surface shares the planet's warm subject/palette but the sampled boundary is a direct change of view.
examples.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Similar subject matter is not proof of continuous motion.

examples.title: Control: explosion to kitchen consequence
examples.carry: The explosion is followed by a direct return to the kitchen; it does not visibly reveal the room through an organic wipe.
examples.mechanism: Ordinary cut. Do not label every animated explosion an object-driven transition.

limits: Source footage shows visible action, not the private rig, scene graph or interpolation curves.
GIFs are silent 25fps study excerpts; artificial loop restarts are not source transitions.
Only dense sheets are consecutive-frame studies; survey and ordinary sheets are spaced samples.
Portrait short-form cutting density is not a target for the nine-minute landscape episode.
No narration/SFX performance is inferred from silent evidence.
This script produces evidence, not a quality pass or replacement film.
